description: smoke:qc pipeline, formatting, lint, and typecheck wiring
spec:
1. Confirm root package.json exposes format, lint, typecheck, and smoke:qc scripts.
2. Ensure bunfig.toml sets env = false (JSON-only config, no .env).
3. Run `bun run smoke:qc` and confirm it passes on the scaffold.
4. Verify prettier config (tabs, 100 cols, single quotes) is honored.
5. Confirm ESLint runs with --max-warnings 0 and reports zero warnings.
title: Quality gate and tooling
